picks.editorial_note: CERN and Mistral's strategic partnership to build a foundation model trained on billions of simulated LHC collisions marks one of the most significant science/industry AI pairings this week, with potential to reshape how particle physics data is analyzed.
picks.title: CERN and Mistral join forces to accelerate AI for science – Home

picks.editorial_note: DOE's Genesis Mission, spotlighted at the National Academy of Engineering meeting, is a national-scale initiative linking supercomputers, datasets, and experimental facilities to accelerate scientific discovery — a major federal policy bet on AI-driven science.
picks.title: NAE Annual Meeting Spotlights DOE’s New Genesis Project and Other AI Initiatives Aimed at Advancing Discovery

picks.editorial_note: A White House-announced Southeast Regional Super-Intelligence Computing Consortium bringing together 14+ universities signals a coordinated regional push on AI infrastructure with direct federal backing.
picks.title: Vanderbilt among founding members of Southeast Regional SI Computing Consortium

picks.editorial_note: A $28.6 million federally funded multi-institution project including Brown to study neurodegenerative disease via machine learning represents substantial new investment at the intersection of AI and biomedical research.
picks.title: Brown scholar to play key role in federally funded project to prevent neurodegenerative disease

picks.editorial_note: A $19.2 million, five-year Army Research Office award to a UCF-led team to advance optical sensing and computational imaging is a major defense-research funding commitment with broad scientific scope.
picks.title: UCF-Led Team Receives $19.2 Million Army Research Office Award to Advance the Science of Light

picks.editorial_note: Arkansas's AURORA project, part of a $20 million NSF-led effort to build a robot-controlled, AI-enhanced autonomous laboratory, exemplifies the growing trend of AI-accelerated materials discovery backed by significant federal funding.
picks.title: Robots and AI Could Speed Search for Quantum Materials

picks.editorial_note: Rico Sennrich's ACL Test of Time Award for inventing subword tokenization (BPE) recognizes a foundational technique underlying nearly every modern large language model — a decade-later validation of a true scientific breakthrough.
picks.title: A Smart Computer

picks.editorial_note: UIUC's ESMDynamic model, which predicts protein motion dramatically faster than traditional molecular dynamics simulations, could meaningfully accelerate structural biology and drug discovery research.
picks.title: AI model offers a faster way to explore how proteins move, study finds

picks.editorial_note: Georgia Tech's work to detect internal warning signs of unsafe or misaligned AI behavior addresses a pressing AI-safety challenge, motivated by a real 2026 incident, and could inform future safety practices industry-wide.
picks.title: Can We Detect Harmful AI Before It’s Too Late? Researchers Search for Warning Signs

picks.editorial_note: HKUST's EmArm, an embodied robotic arm with human-like whole-arm tactile sensing, demonstrates a tangible scientific advance in giving robots more nuanced physical perception and manipulation abilities.
picks.title: HKUST Develops Embodied Robotic Arm “EmArm” with Human-Like Touch Sensing
